entities.summary: Leader of Papua New Guinea (1980–1982, 1994–1997). PPP; Sandline Affair 1997 (hired South African mercenaries to fight Bougainville, military commander Jerry Singirok mutinied, constitutional crisis, Chan forced to resign, scandalized internationally)
